is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses exclusively on Aedes aegypti mosquitoes.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports SNPs in the voltage-gated sodium channel (VGSC) gene, which are associated with pyrethroid resistance (kdr) in Aedes aegypti (Table 3, page 8).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 provides genotype frequencies (e.g., T 100%, T 77% C 23%) and read depths for specific SNPs in the VGSC gene.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses mosquitoes collected from Cairns (Australia) and Bangkok (Thailand). No African field populations were included.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study using RNA-Seq on field-collected mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: The paper specifies collection locations in Cairns (Earlville, Bungalow, Parramatta Park, Manoora) and Bangkok (page 8).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new RNA-Seq data generated from field-collected mosquitoes.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data for the assessment is contained within the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study characterizes the virome of wild-caught Aedes aegypti from Cairns, Australia, and Bangkok, Thailand, using RNA-Seq. It also analyzes mitochondrial diversity and insecticide resistance-associated SNPs in the VGSC gene. The study does not involve Anopheles mosquitoes or African field populations.
